map._comment: The generated map, the world played (#472, decision 0012): recipe (modules/world/data/maps/<recipe>.json) and seed, each overridden by --map= and --seed= (a missing or broken --map= falls back to this recipe); anything that falls kill_depth metres below the map's lowest ground (below 0 on the flat test world) is lost; the car waits car_ahead metres from the camp toward the highway and car_side metres to its right.

roads._comment: How worn the map's roads are by how remote they are (0 by a settlement, 1 far from people, see the recipe's remoteness): wear and potholes go from [0] at 0 to [1] at 1 (what generation starts with; damage players do stays).

water._comment: How ponds look (the map recipe places them): shallow and deep water colours [r, g, b] and colour_depth (metres to fully deep), shore_colour within shore_depth metres of the bank, sky (the reflected colour), wind [x, z] (ripple direction and strength), ripple_speed and ripple_seconds.

scatter._comment: Trees, rocks and grass (TWEAKING.md lists the rest). site_clearance: metres round each map site's pad, by site kind, kept free of trees and rocks so they don't crowd what stands there; default for kinds not listed. power_clearance: metres either side of a high-voltage line and of a pole line (at most 32) kept free of trees and rocks, so no crown grows into the wires.
